<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Winter's Clutch](/Feats.aspx?ID=4269) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Cold" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=27" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 32

</column>

---

Gleaming flakes of chilling snow fall in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet. Each creature in the area takes 2d4 cold damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. The ground in the area is covered in a snow drift, which is [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453). Each square of the drift lasts until it melts, either naturally or until fire damage is dealt in that square.

---
**Level (+2)** The damage increases by 1d4.
name: Winter's Clutch
